div.span: First Time in Europe in English

div.p: Now ICF-accredited — each workshop carries 3 ICF CCEs (1.5 Resource Development + 1.5 Core Competencies). Use of TRE™ in a coaching context — a half-day intensive exploring how neurogenic tremoring can deepen your somatic presence, prevent burnout and transform the way you work with clients. Taught in English.

div.h3: From Shaking to Shaping · Bucharest · 20 October 2026

img.alt: From Shaking to Shaping — full course details: who this coaching experience is for and what we will cover

div.h2: What Is From Shaking to Shaping?
div.p: TRE™ (Tension, Stress & Trauma Releasing Exercises) activates the body's natural tremoring response — a neurogenic mechanism that discharges accumulated stress, tension and trauma from the nervous system.

In this workshop you will explore how to use TRE™ within your coaching practice — not just as a self-care tool, but as a somatic method that helps clients move from a state of activation to regulated presence, from trembling uncertainty to purposeful, embodied action.

ul.li: The neuroscience behind neurogenic tremoring and nervous system regulation
How to integrate TRE™ into 1-on-1 and group coaching contexts
Somatic self-care practices to prevent compassion fatigue and burnout
Embodied presence and body-led listening skills as a coach
A full TRE™ session experience guided by a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer

div.p: Taught in English · In-person sessions also available in Romanian
One online session and two in-person sessions in Bucharest — each a standalone half-day intensive.
10:00–13:00 EET (Eastern European Time) · Online via Zoom
Free if you register for TRE™ Module 1 (Oct 15–17 2026) or full TRE™ certification on the same cohort.
19:00–22:00 EET · Bucharest, România · Facilitated in English and Romanian
Free if you register for TRE™ Module 1 (March 2027 cohort) or full TRE™ certification on the same cohort.
14:30–17:30 EET · Bucharest, România · Facilitated in English and Romanian
Free if you register for TRE™ Module 1 (March 2027 cohort) or full TRE™ certification on the same cohort.

div.span: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · ICF PCC
div.p: Somatic and Trauma-informed Executive Coach (ICF PCC), Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer and Mindfulness Teacher. Trained directly under Dr. David Berceli, founder of TRE™. Over 30 years of experience across 9 countries and 40+ nationalities.

Founder & President, Asociația TRE™ România. Holistic Coach, Trainer & Mentor, Certified TRE™ Provider and Trainer Trainee. Pioneer of TRE™ in Romania, bringing embodied healing and somatic practices to the Romanian professional community.

div.div: In collaboration with: Învață să Zbori SRL (Learn to Fly) · TRE™ România · BHD Asia

div.p: The Bucharest sessions on 20 & 24 October 2026 have taken place.
